JUDGEMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the PSI of Parappana Agrahara police police station against the accused No.1 & 2 for the offences punishable U/Sec.506, 504, 341, 498A R/W 34 IPC.
02.

It is the case of the prosecution that, the accused No.1 is the husband of CW.1 Smt.Janaki got married on 22.10.1999 at Bengaluru, as per Hindu customers thereafter the marriage of CW.1, the accused persons along with their two children were resided within the limits of Parappana Agrahara Police Station, Bengaluru and thereafter on 27.05.2022 the accused persons with common intention wrongfully restrained her from proceeding further and picked up quarrel with CW.1 in respect of silly reasons and abused her in filthy language and assaulted with hands and they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the offences.

03. After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offences punishable U/Sec.506,
504, 341, 498A R/W 34 IPC and issued summons to the accused persons.
Accordingly the accused persons appeared before the court through their counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on, charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused persons under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.
As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused persons, the charges has been framed and the same were read over to them, but they pleaded not guilty and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.
05. In furtherance of the charges leveled against the accused, the following points are arisen for my consideration.
POINTS 01.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 is the husband of CW.1 Smt.Janaki got married on 22.10.1999 at Bengaluru, as per Hindu customers thereafter the marriage of CW.1, the accused persons along with their two children were resided within the limits of Parappana Agrahara Police Station, Bengaluru and thereafter on 27.05.2022 the accused persons with common intention wrongfully restrained her from proceeding further and picked up quarrel with CW.1 in respect of silly reasons and abused her in filthy language and assaulted with hands and they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the offence punishable U/Sec. U/Sec.506, 504, 341, 498A R/W 34 IPC ?

Parappana Agrahara Police vs Murugan Sp on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53062647/
2 02.
What order or Sentence ?
06. In order to prove the case, the prosecution has examined CW.1 as PW.1 and got marked the documents as per Ex.P1 & Ex.P2.

On consideration of the hostile evidence of PW1, I felt that, no purpose will be served on examination of other witnesses i.e. CW.2 to CW.8 and rejected the prayer of learned Sr.A.P.P for further evidence and got closed the evidence of prosecution and the accused statement U/sec.313 of Cr.P.C is dispensed with as there are no incriminating evidence appeared against him and posted the case for arguments.
07. Heard the arguments.
My findings on the above said points are as follows:-
Point No.1 : In the negative.

Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 08. POINT No.1 :- The prosecution has been launched on the basis of complaint lodged by the CW1 for the offence punishable U/Sec.506, 504, 341, 498A R/W 34 IPC and investigation was taken place on the allegation made by the complainant/CW1 as per the contents of the complaint/Ex.P1.
To prove the case, prosecution has examined CW-1 as PW-1 who is the informant,
She deposed that, the accused No.1 is her husband and the accused No.2 is her husband's friend and they never caused any quarrel with her, not assaulted her and abused her in filthy language.
She has deposed that, due to some minor differences with the accused persons and in this regard she has gone to the police station.
Then the police have obtained her signature to the complaint and mahazar Ex. P 1 and P 2.
She has deposed that, now she has compromised the dispute with the accused persons.
Though the CW.1 identified her signature on Ex.P.1 and 2, she has deposed that she did not know the contents of Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
Further, she has specifically deposed that, the police have not seized any property in her presence.
The PW.1 being the victim has also not deposed about the quarrel or injury caused by accused.
The PW.1 completely turned hostile.

The learned Sr.APP has treated the PW.1 as a hostile witness and cross-examined her by suggesting the case of the prosecution, but nothing worth evidence has been elicited from her to support the case of the prosecution.
She has specifically deposed that, she has compromised the dispute with the accused persons.

09. Here it is pertinent to note that, PW.1 has not at all deposed regarding any of the allegations or incident as appeared in the contents of the complaint and Charge-Sheet and nothing has been elicited from her mouth during her cross-examination done by the prosecution.
Then, the doubt arises in the mind of the Court regarding the case of the prosecution to bring home the guilt of the accused persons.
Thus, there are no any incriminating materials to establish the alleged offences leveled against the accused persons.
Therefore, the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the alleged offences against the accused No.1 & 2 beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answered the Point No.1 in the negative.
10. POINT NO.2:

In view of reasons stated above on points No.1, I proceed to pass the following:

2 are acquitted for the offences punishable U/Sec.506, 504, 341, 498A R/W 34 of IPC.

The bail bond and surety bond of the accused No.1 & 2 shall continue in force for a period of 6 months for the purposes of section 437(A) of Cr.P.C.
The accused No.1 & 2 are set at liberty.
